_comment: The site: which room holds what. Devices are referenced by id and defined once elsewhere: screens in publish-destinations.json (with their live settings), lamps in config/room/patch.yaml (Hue, hue.<id>), "light" names every DMX light registered on the Lights setup page (show_service's rig, light.<id>), blinds in config/room/rf/blinds.json, sensors in the light relay config, effects are devices, each an on/off target plus setting targets ({power, settings}: the glitterball, config/room/rf/glitterball.json; any device added in Settings › Lights, config/room/rf/<id>.json); their names and words come from that config and the modes.json labels. The Room page renders one section per room from this file; room_service derives '<room>:<kind>' groups (e.g. drawing-room:blinds) for modes.json.
